description: Source file implementing the LayoutPlanner class for memory layout planning in PyTorch's native runtime, including constructor logic, plan creation, and periodic updates.

classes.name: LayoutPlanner
classes.description: Class responsible for planning memory layouts for tensors in a computational graph, managing allocation specs, and periodically updating plans based on execution history.

methods.name: LayoutPlanner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout planner with graph, kernel schemas, persistent values, and settings, setting up algorithms and initial plan.

methods.name: initialize_vectors
methods.description: Initializes internal vectors based on allocation specifications.

methods.name: get_planned_values
methods.description: Returns the list of planned tensor value IDs.

methods.name: get_unplanned_values
methods.description: Returns the list of unplanned tensor value IDs.

methods.name: start_worker_if_not_started
methods.description: Starts a background thread to periodically update the memory plan.

methods.name: create_plan
methods.description: Creates or updates the memory layout plan based on current specifications and historical maximum sizes.

methods.name: run_periodic
methods.description: Runs a given function periodically at intervals specified in settings.
